entries.11a578228bf894a0: A service that supports EDI between PLANET-participating manufacturers and wholesalers, which can be carried out easily on a personal computer over the internet.
entries.138527d6f47e7213: These are services such as the 'Trading Partner Database,' which provides information on the 'Standard Trading Partner Codes' used to designate delivery destinations for EDI services.
entries.1541b81a68a161f9: Pet food and pet supplies manufacturers
entries.3fb9367e15c28859: An EDI service that supports efficiency in transaction operations between wholesalers and manufacturers in the daily necessities and cosmetics, pet food and pet supplies, and OTC drug industries, among others, with 20 types of data from ordering through settlement in operation.
entries.46bc96e0cbcbecd1: These are services such as the 'Trading Partner Database,' which provides information on the 'Standard Trading Partner Codes' used to designate delivery destinations for EDI services. Users can search and use information on approximately 520,000 locations nationwide, including retail stores and logistics centers of wholesalers. Note that the 'Product Database' service ended at the end of March 2026 following the transfer of its operations and functions to Purodakuto Rejisutorī Sābisu Co., Ltd.
entries.5148fc0d5b34ada6: This is a service that handles the data exchange necessary for commercial transactions among material suppliers, manufacturers, and wholesalers.
entries.5477a4b4102cb548: This is a service that supports two-way data exchange between wholesalers that use core EDI and their supplier manufacturers, and order processing and the creation and transmission of purchasing information can be done in a Web browser.
entries.7f8750a9076dd4d6: This EDI service supports efficiency in transaction operations between consumer goods manufacturers and materials suppliers, and runs 15 types of data covering everything from orders to settlement.
entries.852d8d34d22a8f39: This is a service that handles the data exchange necessary for commercial transactions among material suppliers, manufacturers, and wholesalers. By using an industry-standard format and standardized codes, participating companies can easily start EDI with multiple companies. This is the company's core service and accounted for the entire amount of revenue in sales results for the fiscal year ended July 2026.
entries.a74c0bad74bbda5e: This is a service in which the company receives on behalf of wholesalers the sales data sent from wholesalers to manufacturers, and provides standard reports compiled and processed from that data, and data extracted under specified conditions, on a daily basis on Baiyāzu Netto.
entries.c375fb2ff4a5acbf: This is an initiative to exchange various logistics data between manufacturers and wholesalers, and the use of shipping schedule data (ASN data) is spreading, mainly among major companies in the daily goods and cosmetics industries.
entries.f8a56035d1e08293: A company that provides EDI services for exchanging transaction data, such as orders and order receipts, between manufacturers of daily necessities, cosmetics and similar goods and wholesalers.
